system.description: A reliable source of blood, whether cultists, a blood bank contact, or a religious following. Each Herd Trait can be spent once per session to gain one extra Blood Trait, either immediately upon entering play or by taking 15 minutes out of play to call on the herd. Herd members are not necessarily competent or loyal beyond providing blood — take Allies or Retainers for that.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
